not_testable_rules.rescue_fraction: excluded when |T| < 0.5 nats or |T| <= 10 x clean-replay hook no-op error
not_testable_rules.link_family: two-sided empirical p with Bonferroni correction across six ordered pairs
not_testable_rules.sweep: descriptive matched pairs; 16 of 20 is not a significance test
not_testable_rules.grid_slope: 43.10 is NOT_TESTABLE until a positive minimum absolute slope magnitude is preregistered; intervals resample template clusters and require same-sign endpoints
